description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {U/B}.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.
